-- Typed request and runner/service state. JSON is confined to validation and output.
pub type StepDefinition = StepDefinition {
  id: String,
  needs: List(String),
  amount: Int,
  failures: Int
}

pub type Checkpoint = AfterBegin | AfterCall deriving (Eq)

pub type Command
  = Start(String)
  | Tick(Option(Checkpoint))
  | Advance(Int)
  | Observe
  | Crash
  | Restart
  | Cancel(String)

pub type Workflow = Workflow {
  steps: List(StepDefinition),
  commands: List(Command),
  max_attempts: Int,
  retry_delay: Int
}

pub type StepStatus = Pending | Running | Succeeded | Failed | Blocked | Cancelled deriving (Eq)
-- RunFailing exists only in leased mode; the legacy runner never produces it.
pub type RunStatus = RunActive | RunSucceeded | RunFailed | RunCancelling | RunCancelled | RunFailing deriving (Eq)

-- A durable lease held by the worker currently owning a running step (leased mode only).
pub type Lease = Lease { worker: String, ticket: Int, expires: Int }

pub type StepState = StepState {
  id: String,
  status: StepStatus,
  attempts: Int,
  ready_at: Int,
  lease: Option(Lease)
}

pub type RunState = RunState {
  id: String,
  status: RunStatus,
  cancel_requested: Bool,
  steps: List(StepState)
}

-- Structured idempotency key: both components are kept separate, never concatenated.
pub type ActionKey = ActionKey { run_id: String, step_id: String } deriving (Eq)

pub type CallKind = ExecuteCall | LookupCall deriving (Eq)
pub type CallOutcome = Applied | Replayed | Transient | Found | Missing deriving (Eq)

-- worker/ticket identify the invoking lease in leased mode; the legacy adapter leaves them None.
pub type ServiceCall = ServiceCall {
  worker: Option(String),
  ticket: Option(Int),
  kind: CallKind,
  key: ActionKey,
  attempt: Int,
  outcome: CallOutcome
}
pub type Effect = Effect { key: ActionKey, amount: Int }
pub type MockService = MockService { calls: List(ServiceCall), effects: List(Effect) }

pub type Snapshot = Snapshot { now: Int, up: Bool, runs: List(RunState) }
pub type Simulator = Simulator {
  now: Int,
  up: Bool,
  runs: List(RunState),
  service: MockService,
  observations: List(Snapshot)
}

pub type Action = Action { run: RunState, step: StepState, definition: StepDefinition }

pub fn time_limit() : Int = 2147483647

-- Leased mode (checkpoint two): workers, tickets and the split claim/call/deliver protocol.
pub type LeasedCommand
  = LStart(String)
  | LAdvance(Int)
  | LObserve
  | LCrash(String)
  | LRestart(String)
  | LClaim(String)
  | LRenew(String, Int)
  | LCall(String, Int)
  | LDeliver(Int)
  | LCancel(String)

pub type LeasedWorkflow = LeasedWorkflow {
  steps: List(StepDefinition),
  commands: List(LeasedCommand),
  workers: List(String),
  max_attempts: Int,
  retry_delay: Int,
  lease_duration: Int
}

-- A request is either the frozen checkpoint-one contract or the leased protocol.
pub type Request = Legacy(Workflow) | Leased(LeasedWorkflow)

pub type WorkerState = WorkerState { id: String, up: Bool }

-- Ticket metadata survives worker crashes: it models a delayed transport message.
pub type Ticket = Ticket {
  id: Int,
  worker: String,
  run_id: String,
  step_id: String,
  attempt: Int,
  kind: CallKind,
  response: Option(CallOutcome),
  delivered: Bool
}

pub type LeasedSnapshot = LeasedSnapshot { now: Int, workers: List(WorkerState), runs: List(RunState) }

pub type CommandResult
  = RNull
  | RTicket(Option(Int))
  | RRenewed(Bool)
  | RReceipt(CallKind, CallOutcome)
  | RStale
  | RCommitted(Bool)
  | RSnapshot(LeasedSnapshot)

pub type LeasedSimulator = LeasedSimulator {
  now: Int,
  workers: List(WorkerState),
  runs: List(RunState),
  tickets: List(Ticket),
  next_ticket: Int,
  service: MockService,
  results: List(CommandResult)
}

pub type Outcome = LegacyOutcome(Simulator) | LeasedOutcome(LeasedSimulator)

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)

fn ensure(valid : Bool, code : String) : Result(Unit, String) =
  if valid then Ok(()) else Err(code)

fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

fn fields(value : Json, required : List(String), optional : List(String)) : Result(List((String, Json)), String) =
  match value of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      let keys = map(\(pair) -> fst(pair), pairs)
      let _ = ensure(unique(keys) && all(\(key) -> elem(key, keys), required)
          && all(\(key) -> elem(key, append(required, optional)), keys), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(pairs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn get_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => JNull

fn optional_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String, default : Json) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => default

fn integer(value : Json, low : Int, high : Int) : Result(Int, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(n) =>
      let _ = ensure(n >= low && n <= high, "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(n)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn valid_id_bytes(s : String, i : Int) : Bool =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then true
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
      || (c >= 48 && c <= 57) || c == 95 || c == 45) && valid_id_bytes(s, i + 1)

fn identifier(value : Json) : Result(String, String) =
  match value of
    JStr(s) =>
      let _ = ensure(byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 64 && valid_id_bytes(s, 0), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(s)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn array(value : Json) : Result(List(Json), String) =
  match value of
    JArr(xs) => Ok(xs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_ids(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(String), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let name = identifier(x)?
      let names = parse_ids(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(name, names))

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

fn parse_steps(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(StepDefinition), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let step = parse_step(x)?
      let steps = parse_steps(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(step, steps))

fn parse_checkpoint(obj : List((String, Json))) : Result(Option(Checkpoint), String) =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "crash_at", obj) of
    None => Ok(None)
    Some(pair) =>
      match snd(pair) of
        JStr(name) =>
          if name == "after_begin" then Ok(Some(AfterBegin))
          elif name == "after_call" then Ok(Some(AfterCall))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

-- Kahn's algorithm permits forward references while detecting self and multi-step cycles.
fn acyclic(remaining : List(StepDefinition), visited : List(String)) : Bool =
  if is_nil(remaining) then true
  else
    let ready = filter(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, visited), step.needs), remaining)
    if is_nil(ready) then false
    else
      let seen = append(visited, map(\(step) -> step.id, ready))
      acyclic(filter(\(step) -> not(elem(step.id, seen)), remaining), seen)

fn validate_graph(steps : List(StepDefinition)) : Result(Unit, String) =
  let ids = map(\(step) -> step.id, steps)
  let _ = ensure(unique(ids), "DUPLICATE_STEP")?
  let _ = ensure(all(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, ids), step.needs), steps), "UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY")?
  ensure(acyclic(steps, []), "DEPENDENCY_CYCLE")

fn parse_legacy_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

-- Leased-mode commands: the old tick/checkpoint vocabulary is not accepted here.
fn parse_leased_command(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then LStart(id) else LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" || op == "restart" || op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then LCrash(worker) elif op == "restart" then LRestart(worker) else LClaim(worker))
          elif op == "renew" || op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(if op == "renew" then LRenew(worker, ticket) else LCall(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_leased_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(LeasedCommand), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_leased_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_leased_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

fn parse_leased_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedWorkflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let _ = ensure(length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let workers = parse_ids(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_leased_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let lease = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(LeasedWorkflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, workers = workers,
    max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = lease })

-- The presence of `workers` selects the leased protocol; otherwise the frozen contract applies.
pub fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Request, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      if any(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "workers", pairs) then
        let leased = parse_leased_workflow(raw)?
        Ok(Leased(leased))
      else
        let legacy = parse_legacy_workflow(raw)?
        Ok(Legacy(legacy))
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: new_leased
leased_snapshot
defs.source:
fn leased_snapshot(sim : LeasedSimulator) : LeasedSnapshot =
  LeasedSnapshot { now = sim.now, workers = sim.workers, runs = sim.runs }

defs.name: lease_live
defs.source:
fn lease_live(now : Int, lease : Option(Lease)) : Bool =
  match lease of
    Some(l) => now < l.expires
    None => false

defs.name: lease_ticket
defs.source:
fn lease_ticket(lease : Option(Lease)) : Int =
  match lease of
    Some(l) => l.ticket
    None => 0

defs.name: expire_lease
defs.source:
fn expire_lease(now : Int, step : StepState) : StepState =
  match step.lease of
    Some(l) => if step.status == Running then StepState { ..step, lease = Some(Lease { ..l, expires = now }) } else step
    None => step

defs.name: expire_running
defs.source:
fn expire_running(now : Int, run : RunState) : RunState =
  RunState { ..run, steps = map(\(step) -> expire_lease(now, step), run.steps) }

defs.name: has_running
defs.source: fn has_running(run : RunState) : Bool = any(\(step) -> step.status == Running, run.steps)

defs.name: replace_step
defs.source:
fn replace_step(run : RunState, replacement : StepState) : RunState =
  RunState { ..run, steps = map(\(step) -> if step.id == replacement.id then replacement else step, run.steps) }

defs.name: replace_run
defs.source:
fn replace_run(sim : LeasedSimulator, replacement : RunState) : LeasedSimulator =
  LeasedSimulator { ..sim, runs = map(\(run) -> if run.id == replacement.id then replacement else run, sim.runs) }

defs.name: replace_ticket
defs.source:
fn replace_ticket(sim : LeasedSimulator, replacement : Ticket) : LeasedSimulator =
  LeasedSimulator { ..sim, tickets = map(\(t) -> if t.id == replacement.id then replacement else t, sim.tickets) }

defs.name: set_worker
defs.source:
fn set_worker(sim : LeasedSimulator, id : String, up : Bool) : LeasedSimulator =
  LeasedSimulator { ..sim, workers = map(\(w) -> if w.id == id then WorkerState { ..w, up = up } else w, sim.workers) }

defs.name: mark_pending
defs.source:
fn mark_pending(run : RunState, status : StepStatus) : RunState =
  RunState { ..run, steps = map(\(step) -> if step.status == Pending then StepState { ..step, status = status } else step, run.steps) }

defs.name: find_run
defs.source:
fn find_run(sim : LeasedSimulator, id : String) : Option(RunState) =
  find(\(run) -> run.id == id, sim.runs)

defs.name: find_step
defs.source:
fn find_step(run : RunState, id : String) : Option(StepState) =
  find(\(step) -> step.id == id, run.steps)

defs.name: find_definition
defs.source:
fn find_definition(workflow : LeasedWorkflow, id : String) : Option(StepDefinition) =
  find(\(definition) -> definition.id == id, workflow.steps)

defs.name: find_worker
defs.source:
fn find_worker(sim : LeasedSimulator, id : String) : Option(WorkerState) =
  find(\(w) -> w.id == id, sim.workers)

defs.name: worker_up
defs.source:
fn worker_up(sim : LeasedSimulator, id : String) : Bool =
  match find_worker(sim, id) of
    Some(w) => w.up
    None => false

defs.name: require_worker
defs.source:
fn require_worker(sim : LeasedSimulator, id : String) : Result(WorkerState, String) =
  match find_worker(sim, id) of
    Some(w) => Ok(w)
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_WORKER")

defs.name: require_up
find_ticket
defs.source:
fn find_ticket(sim : LeasedSimulator, id : Int) : Option(Ticket) =
  find(\(t) -> t.id == id, sim.tickets)

defs.name: require_owned_ticket
defs.source:
fn require_owned_ticket(sim : LeasedSimulator, worker : String, id : Int) : Result(Ticket, String) =
  match find_ticket(sim, id) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
    Some(t) => if t.worker == worker then Ok(t) else Err("WRONG_WORKER")

defs.name: ticket_step
defs.source:
fn ticket_step(sim : LeasedSimulator, ticket : Ticket) : Option((RunState, StepState)) =
  match find_run(sim, ticket.run_id) of
    None => None
    Some(run) =>
      match find_step(run, ticket.step_id) of
        None => None
        Some(step) => Some((run, step))

defs.name: current_live
held_by
defs.source:
fn held_by(now : Int, worker : String, step : StepState) : Bool =
  match step.lease of
    Some(l) => step.status == Running && l.worker == worker && now < l.expires
    None => false

defs.name: worker_busy
defs.source:
fn worker_busy(sim : LeasedSimulator, worker : String) : Bool =
  any(\(run) -> any(\(step) -> held_by(sim.now, worker, step), run.steps), sim.runs)

defs.name: deps_succeeded
defs.source:
fn deps_succeeded(run : RunState, definition : StepDefinition) : Bool =
  all(\(dep) -> any(\(s) -> s.id == dep && s.status == Succeeded, run.steps), definition.needs)

defs.name: select_step
select_run
defs.source:
fn select_run(now : Int, expired : Bool, runs : List(RunState), definitions : List(StepDefinition)) : Option(Action) =
  match runs of
    Nil => None
    Cons(run, rest) =>
      match select_step(now, expired, run, run.steps, definitions) of
        Some(action) => Some(action)
        None => select_run(now, expired, rest, definitions)

defs.name: select_work
defs.source:
fn select_work(sim : LeasedSimulator, workflow : LeasedWorkflow) : Option(Action) =
  match select_run(sim.now, true, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
    Some(action) => Some(action)
    None => select_run(sim.now, false, sim.runs, workflow.steps)

defs.name: deliver
defs.source:
fn deliver(sim : LeasedSimulator, workflow : LeasedWorkflow, id : Int) : Result((LeasedSimulator, CommandResult), String) =
  match find_ticket(sim, id) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
    Some(ticket) =>
      match ticket.response of
        None => Ok((sim, RCommitted(false)))
        Some(outcome) =>
          if ticket.delivered || not(current_live(sim, ticket)) || not(worker_up(sim, ticket.worker)) then
            Ok((sim, RCommitted(false)))
          else
            match ticket_step(sim, ticket) of
              None => Ok((sim, RCommitted(false)))
              Some(pair) =>
                let cleared = StepState { ..snd(pair), lease = None }
                let committed = commit(sim, workflow, fst(pair), cleared, ticket.kind, outcome)?
                let updated = replace_ticket(replace_run(sim, committed), Ticket { ..ticket, delivered = true })
                Ok((updated, RCommitted(true)))

defs.source:
fn apply_leased(sim : LeasedSimulator, workflow : LeasedWorkflow, command : LeasedCommand) : Result((LeasedSimulator, CommandResult), String) =
  match command of
    LStart(id) =>
      let started = new_run(sim, workflow, id)?
      Ok((started, RNull))
    LAdvance(by) =>
      if sim.now + by > time_limit() then Err("TIME_OVERFLOW")
      else Ok((LeasedSimulator { ..sim, now = sim.now + by }, RNull))
    LObserve => Ok((sim, RSnapshot(leased_snapshot(sim))))
    LCrash(worker) =>
      let w = require_worker(sim, worker)?
      if not(w.up) then Err("WORKER_DOWN") else Ok((set_worker(sim, worker, false), RNull))
    LRestart(worker) =>
      let w = require_worker(sim, worker)?
      if w.up then Err("WORKER_UP") else Ok((set_worker(sim, worker, true), RNull))
    LClaim(worker) => claim(sim, workflow, worker)
    LRenew(worker, id) => renew(sim, workflow, worker, id)
    LCall(worker, id) => call(sim, workflow, worker, id)
    LDeliver(id) => deliver(sim, workflow, id)
    LCancel(id) =>
      match find_run(sim, id) of
        None => Err("UNKNOWN_RUN")
        Some(run) => Ok((cancel(sim, run), RNull))

defs.name: run_leased

fn run_leased(sim : LeasedSimulator, workflow : LeasedWorkflow, commands : List(LeasedCommand)) : Result(LeasedSimulator, String) =
  match commands of
    Nil => Ok(sim)
    Cons(command, rest) =>
      let step = apply_leased(sim, workflow, command)?
      let next = fst(step)
      run_leased(LeasedSimulator { ..next, results = append(next.results, [snd(step)]) }, workflow, rest)

defs.ty: (Domain.MockService, Option(String), Option(Int), Domain.ActionKey, Int, Int, Int) -> (Domain.MockService, Domain.CallOutcome)
defs.source:
fn execute_as(service : MockService, worker : Option(String), ticket : Option(Int), key : ActionKey, amount : Int, attempt : Int, failures : Int) : (MockService, CallOutcome) =
  if has_effect(service, key) then
    (audit(service, worker, ticket, ExecuteCall, key, attempt, Replayed), Replayed)
  elif transient_count(service, key) < failures then
    (audit(service, worker, ticket, ExecuteCall, key, attempt, Transient), Transient)
  else
    let applied = MockService { ..service, effects = append(service.effects, [Effect { key = key, amount = amount }]) }
    (audit(applied, worker, ticket, ExecuteCall, key, attempt, Applied), Applied)

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

fn parse_legacy_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

defs.name: parse_leased_command
defs.source:
fn parse_leased_command(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then LStart(id) else LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" || op == "restart" || op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then LCrash(worker) elif op == "restart" then LRestart(worker) else LClaim(worker))
          elif op == "renew" || op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(if op == "renew" then LRenew(worker, ticket) else LCall(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

  match xs of

      let command = parse_leased_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_leased_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

defs.name: parse_leased_workflow
defs.source:
fn parse_leased_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedWorkflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let _ = ensure(length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let workers = parse_ids(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_leased_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let lease = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(LeasedWorkflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, workers = workers,
    max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = lease })

defs.name: parse_workflow
defs.source:
fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Request, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      if any(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "workers", pairs) then
        let leased = parse_leased_workflow(raw)?
        Ok(Leased(leased))
      else
        let legacy = parse_legacy_workflow(raw)?
        Ok(Legacy(legacy))
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: handle_request
defs.source:
fn handle_request(line : String) : Result(Outcome, String) =
  let request = map_err(\(_) -> "INVALID_INPUT", decode_lossy(line))?
  match request of
    JObj(fields) =>
      let workflow = parse_workflow(get_field(fields, "input"))?
      match workflow of
        Legacy(legacy) =>
          let sim = simulate(legacy)?
          Ok(LegacyOutcome(sim))
        Leased(leased) =>
          let sim = simulate_leased(leased)?
          Ok(LeasedOutcome(sim))
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
